top_10_recurring_defects.defect: Dashboard quick-action link to the shared inbox renders href="/inbox" without the /t/<tenant> prefix, so it leaves the tenant context.
top_10_recurring_defects.source: app/shared/dashboard_registry.py:365,372; app/shared/dashboard_service.py:721 (url_for without tenant prefix); templates/dashboards/_quick_actions.html:4; templates/errors/403.html:30, 404.html:30, 500.html:30

top_10_recurring_defects.defect: Admin sidebar always shows the clinic-settings link to /doctor/settings even for tenants without the doctor module.
Following that sidebar link yields HTTP 403 (console logs a 403 resource failure) in doctor-less tenants.
Dashboard new-visit quick tile links to /doctor/patient-queue even when doctor is disabled.
Browser console reports failed resource loads (403) on the blocked pages above.
top_10_recurring_defects.source: browser resource-load failures for the 403/404 responses above (same template/route sources)

top_10_recurring_defects.defect: Error pages use an absolute href="/" back-to-home link, dropping the tenant prefix.
top_10_recurring_defects.source: app/shared/dashboard_registry.py:365,372; app/shared/dashboard_service.py:721 (url_for without tenant prefix); templates/dashboards/_quick_actions.html:4; templates/errors/403.html:30, 404.html:30, 500.html:30

top_10_recurring_defects.defect: Portal pages return 403 for the tenant admin because the portal is patient-only (expected role isolation; informational).
/sso/config returns 404 although the integration module is enabled (platform-capability guard hides the route).
/finance/audit navigation timed out after 15s on one tenant (possible slow query).
top_10_recurring_defects.source: slow/timing-out endpoints /finance/audit and /medication/pos on this run
